title: Create, rename and select a workspace, split right and down, move focus, close and reopen a tab
preconditions: a fresh launch: one window, one workspace, one terminal tab

steps.note: a second workspace below the launch's, its first tab a terminal; a socket run files it without showing it
Select Workspace 2 (selectWorkspaceByNumber): the sidebar's second row, the workspace new-workspace made
the sidebar's selection and the topology's focused workspace name the same workspace
a name argument renames the shown workspace; no name field opens
a new terminal pane right of the workspace's pane takes the focus
a new terminal pane below the right pane takes the focus
the focus moves to the workspace's first pane, on the left
New Terminal Tab (newSurface): a second, selected terminal tab in the left pane
closes new-tab's tab into the closed history; its shell runs nothing, so no question is asked
Reopen Last Closed Tab (reopenClosedBrowserPanel): the newest closed group of the key window, the tab close-tab closed, where it was

invariants: the sidebar's selected workspace and the topology's focused workspace are the workspace new-workspace made after every later step
split-right makes a horizontal split and split-down a vertical split of the right pane; each new pane takes the focus, and the layout, topology and focus facets name the same pane
focus-left moves the focus to the left pane, and the responder, the layout focus and Ghostty's focused surface follow it (no InputInvariants.world violation)
close-tab removes one tab and adds one closed history entry; reopen-tab brings that tab back in the left pane and removes the entry
every mutation has one receipt or one typed error (I1)
ids stay stable unless the step created or closed them (I2)
the turn checkpoint of each key step is a prefix of its settled checkpoint (I3)
teardown: quit the tagged app the run started
verify its debug socket is gone
untested: selecting the workspace from Home or with the pointer: the case selects it with Cmd-2
the rename field a run without a name opens on the sidebar row
split ratios after a resize (the workspace-layout case keeps the even split)
the undo toast's own contents after close-tab (the overlays facet is compared, not asserted)
